baselineDateRange.description: Baseline window to compare against. Omit to default to the current window shifted back exactly one week, which absorbs daily and weekly log-volume cycles. Pass an explicit range to compare against a specific period, e.g. pre-deploy or pre-incident.

date_from.description: Start of the date range. Accepts ISO 8601 timestamps or relative formats: -7d, -1h, -1mStart, etc.

date_to.description: End of the date range. Same format as date_from. Omit or null for "now".

query.description: The patterns query for the current (foreground) window: date range plus any severity/service/search/property filters. The same filters are applied to the baseline window.

dateRange.description: Date range to mine patterns from. Defaults to last hour.

date_from.description: Start of the date range. Accepts ISO 8601 timestamps or relative formats: -7d, -1h, -1mStart, etc.

date_to.description: End of the date range. Same format as date_from. Omit or null for "now".

filterGroup.description: Property filters applied before mining. Same shape as the query-logs endpoint.

key.description: Attribute key. For type "log", use "message". For "log_attribute"/"log_resource_attribute", use the attribute key (e.g. "k8s.container.name").

operator.description:
Comparison operator.

* `exact` - exact
* `is_not` - is_not
* `icontains` - icontains
* `not_icontains` - not_icontains
* `starts_with` - starts_with
* `not_starts_with` - not_starts_with
* `ends_with` - ends_with
* `not_ends_with` - not_ends_with
* `regex` - regex
* `not_regex` - not_regex
* `gt` - gt
* `lt` - lt
* `is_date_exact` - is_date_exact
* `is_date_before` - is_date_before
* `is_date_after` - is_date_after
* `is_set` - is_set
* `is_not_set` - is_not_set

type.description:
"log" filters the log body/message. "log_attribute" filters log-level attributes. "log_resource_attribute" filters resource-level attributes.

* `log` - log
* `log_attribute` - log_attribute
* `log_resource_attribute` - log_resource_attribute

value.description: Value to compare against. String, number, or array of strings. Omit for is_set/is_not_set operators.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies before mining.

serviceNames.description: Restrict mining to these service names.

severityLevels.description: Filter by log severity levels before mining.

items.description:
* `trace` - trace
* `debug` - debug
* `info` - info
* `warn` - warn
* `error` - error
* `fatal` - fatal
